notes: A176948_conjecture: for n>=4, n!=6 some n-gonal N is k-gonal for no 3<=k<n. Key: P_n(j)=P_k(i) gives a(bX^2-C)=(aY)^2 with C=(a-b)(ab-4)!=0 (n!=6); per k a prime p_k>n^3 where some X makes a(bX^2-C) a nonresidue (affine map would permute squares; sum of squares = 0 mod p>3); CRT on j. Outside Lean: none.
